name: not-found-page

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the full page cleanly: giant shaded 404, two-line message and both buttons.

tagline: Oversized 404 numerals fade into black above a short apology and two buttons.
summary: A centred error page with huge 404 digits whose lower halves fade out, a two-line explanation and Go Home and Explore buttons. It sits on an empty-state layout with generous negative space.
appearance: A black stage with three enormous white-to-grey numerals, their lower halves dissolving into the background, over two centred lines of white text and a pair of pill buttons, one solid light and one dark with an outline.
behaviour: Static apart from the buttons: each changes fill under the cursor, with Go Home in the solid style and Explore outlined.
demo_content: The headline 404 plus the line about the page being moved or not existing.
search_phrases: go home button on error screen
minimal error page for a website
dead end page with two actions
use_when: A site 404 should feel calm and on-brand instead of showing a browser error.
avoid_when: The links point to #, so it navigates nowhere until you wire the buttons to real routes.
customise: Everything is fixed in the file: the numerals, both lines of copy and the two links, which point to #; changing the text or routes means editing the source.
weight_why: A few lines of text and two buttons; no images or motion.

a11y.note: Clear text and real links, but both targets are #, so they do nothing until routes are added.

issues: Both action links point to #, so neither button navigates anywhere.
polish_why: Big masked numerals and a tidy two-button row; the dead links are the only flaw.
title: Not Found Page
